criteria.criterion: Uses current ownership epoch/lease enforcement at each protected progress/effect/finish transaction, stable operation identities and epoch-conditional renew/release. criteria.evidence: pause-resume schedule, unsafe save_progress excerpt and specified atomic API; no cursor/effect regression oracle.
criteria.rationale: The old epoch-41 unguarded save_progress after epoch-42 cursor 600 is explicitly unsafe. The procedure calls the specified epoch-checked atomic commit_batch and finish operations with stable IDs, maintains ownership until handoff, releases only the current epoch through the specified maintenance_defer, and requires a stale owner to be unable to commit or release successor ownership. These named operations and renewal are read against the pinned contract, whose renew(key,epoch), release(key,epoch) and protected transactions enforce the current epoch/server lease; expiry alone is not credited. The original unfenced r7 cannot be forcibly handed off until no old writer can resume.

The general rule marks any unconfirmed effect/receipt unresolved and inspects the same logical key and stable operation IDs before replay, ACK or release. The forced deadline leaves uncertain outcomes visible for later reconciliation rather than asserting an unconfirmed drain succeeded.
